statement_made: I’m just glad I don’t have to actually run the 'Omaha' plays anymore. Watching from the booth is much better for my neck.

statement_made: I’m a man of my word. I’m going to wait until the time is right, but I know what I’m worth.

statement_made: I think it’s the move to embrace the traditional values that have served our country so well.
